exposure: Induction of labor for a history of fast labor (defined as <5.5 hours)
cohort: Multiparas undergoing elective induction at one high-risk center, categorized into those with a history of fast labor (PFast) and controls with a psychosocial indication.
finding: Women induced for a history of fast labor indeed had significantly faster previous labors, and subsequently delivered more quickly with lower maternal complication rates compared to controls.
mod_finding: Induction of labor in women with a history of fast labor was associated with shorter subsequent delivery times and lower serious maternal complications.
